newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyocera's 97/98 profit seen at record high--paper.
newsitem.headline: Kyocera's 97/98 profit seen at record high--paper.

text.p: Ceramics maker Kyocera Corp is expected to have a record high parent current profit this business year, ending next March 31, a business daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Kyocera is expected to post a parent current profit of 105 billion yen for 1997/98, up eight percent year-on-year.
The daily also said the company's sales of mobile phones and personal handyphone systems (PHS) are robust.
In January, Kyocera said it estimated parent current profit for 1996/97 at 96.5 billion yen.
The Nihon Keizai predicted Kyocera's 1996/97 parent current profit would be 97 billion yen.
A Kyocera spokesman declined to comment on the figures, saying the company's earnings results would be announced on May 16.
He said, however, that sales of mobile phones and personal handyphone systems (PHS) are at a rising trend.
